name: Condition code
description: The states a creature can be in that change what it may do. These are definitions, not occurrences: that a creature is poisoned right now is a Condition record naming one of these codes.

codes.definition: Cannot see, and fails any check that requires sight. Attacks against the creature have advantage, and its own have disadvantage.
Cannot attack the charmer or target them with a harmful effect, and the charmer has advantage on social checks against them.
Cannot hear, and fails any check that requires hearing.
Weariness in degrees, each worse than the last. The severity carries the level.
Has disadvantage while the source of the fear is in sight, and cannot willingly move closer to it.
Speed is zero, and ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the two are moved apart.
Can take no action and no reaction.
Cannot be seen without magic or a special sense. Attacks against the creature have disadvantage, and its own have advantage.
Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, and fails strength and dexterity saves. A hit from within five feet is a critical.
Turned to stone with everything carried. Incapacitated, unaware, and resistant to all damage.
Has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Can only crawl until it stands. Its attacks have disadvantage, and attacks against it have advantage from within five feet.
Speed is zero, its attacks have disadvantage, attacks against it have advantage, and it has disadvantage on dexterity saves.
Incapacitated, cannot move, speaks only falteringly, and fails strength and dexterity saves.
Incapacitated, unaware, prone and unable to hold anything. A hit from within five feet is a critical.
